content: Yesus lernala kenene panatal
Lere onneni Roh Kudus norkaru Yesus laa noho mamun ma napro'uk leke Hayakyak Makromon kene patale.
Lere alam weli'akka raram Ai na'aluli kemen ka na'ak, de namlara wake'e.
Enine Hayakyak Makromon man ken patal onne, mai na'aheni, “Lo'o namlolo kokkoo Makromod Lalap Anan O, hopon waku eniyenihe namwali hanana'an.”
Maa Yesus walhe, “Makromod Lalap na'aheniyedi lolo Horok Lap raram, ‘Ri kan mori nano hanana'an mehe, maa nano Makromod Lalap Lirna na'akeme haenhi.’ ”
Onne horu, Hayakyak Makromon norkaru Ai laa Makromod Lalap Nin kota Yerusalem laa onno man kulu wake'e lolo Makromod Lalap Nin Romleu Lape, la na'aheni,
“Lo'o namlolo kokkoo Makromod Lalap Anan O, nehu laa yawa, ono horhorok aile Lirna Wawan ma na'ahenia,

content.text: ‘Makromod Lalap hopon Nin hophopon a'am raram mai leke radiyaka O. Hir mai paku O leke yom wekur wakue.’ ”

content: Yesus walha, “Maa horhorok aile haenhi ma na'aheni,

content.text: ‘Yon hi'i ha ma kan min haida modi kene Makrommu, ma namwali Makromod Lalap.’ ”

content: Horu ne, Hayakyak Makromon norkaru Yesus laa wo'or man kulu rehi leke An do'on hair-hair na'akeme noro rira linikir kanaru. An nou Yesus na'ahenia,
“Ya ala ha onne na'akeme ki O, horo kadi eum korno yawa, ma'uli masa'a ya'u.”
Maa Yesus walhe, “Hayakyak Makromon o, mala'a here! Horhorok aile man hopon mayai na'ahenia,

content.text: ‘Ma'uli masa'a Makromod Lalap, la derne makani Ai mehe.’ ”

content: Enime'ede Hayakyak Makromon hoikaruwedi Yesus, la hophopon a'am raram mai ilitolle Ai.
Yesus laa Galilea loikaru Makromod Lalap Lirna Wawan eni
Yesus derne nahenia Yohanis aiyedi bui raram me'e ne, Ai namhara Yudea wali wali'ur laa noho Galilea.
Ai namhara Nazaret la minle kota Kapernaum man aile oir lape Galilea herne. Nohorai eniyeni, Yakup anan Zebulon noro Naptali rira nohe.
Yesus min lolo onne leke na'akuku na'anokor inhawa Makromod Lalap na'aheniyedi lolo horok nabi Yesaya nonolu eni, na'ahenia,

content.text: “Lolo ri Zebulon noro Naptali rira nohorai man aile ranrani oir lapa Galilea,
la man aile oir wauwau Yordan wali enne,
ri nammori ma ka namwali Yahudi holi enne.
la Ropropo onne ropa'ahedi hi man minle metmetek kalkala onnenihe me'e.”

content: Nano lere onne me'ede Yesus loikaru Makromod Lalap Lirna Wawan na'aheni, “Herredi minim morimori ma ka namloleni, la derne makani Makromod Lalap, ono Nin lere alam nodi molollo ri mormori na'uraniyedi me'e.”
Yesus napolu ma nohu meki wo'akka
Lerida Yesus nala'ala'a lolo oir lapa Galilea arkan ne, An do'on mo'oni woro'o, Simon (rapolu ‘Petrus’ haenhi) noro mo'oniwalla Andreas. Woro'ohe ma nohu meki de mahar sopol diyale.
Yesus napolu hi na'ahenia, “Mam lernohi Ya'u, leke Ya'u wakuku mi manoin ri mormori naise manoin i'in.”
Idewe hir hoikaruwedi rir diyaleni, la lernohi Ai.
Hi rala'a kan ko'uwala, An do'on ri woro'o wali'ur, Yakobus noro mo'oniwalla Yohanis. Hi roro aman Zebedeus mahanoro tapil dari lolo korkore wawan. Yesus napolu hi, “Mam lernohi Ya'u.”
Idewe hir huri karuwedi aman, kopur laa ro lernohi Yesus.
Yesus hi'i wa'an ri nammori

Onne horu, Yesus laliwewer noho Galilea wakukuwala ri lolo Yahudi rira kerei-kerei. An loikaru Makromod Lirna Wawa'an eni, na'amou na'aropo hi'ihehewi Makromod nodi molollo ri mormori, la An hi'i wa'an ri ma nakni'ir noro man apinha na'akeme.

Enpenia Ai naran pe'eredi lolo Siria ne'en raram me'e, de ri nammori rorkaru man lernala apinha noro ma nakni'ir warna-warna mai Yesus, ma napipi haha'al, ma naplu'uk nap'eker, noro idewe ri man hayakyaka huhu'ur raram haenhi. An hi'i wa'an na'akeme.
Heri nammori mai lolo ewi-ewi lernohi Yesus. Hir mai nano noho Galilea, Dekapolis (napa'ahne, ‘Leke Idaweli’), kota Yerusalem, noho Yudea, noro leke-leke ma aile oir wauwau Yordan wali kimur haenhi.
